primary_selection: Validation correct predictions / all cases with valid price labels, counting missing forecasts as incorrect. At least 70% is a goal, not a guaranteed result. Do not change target, coverage, case membership or labels to meet it.
development: Reuse only the earlier 75 training and 45 validation cases and their saved prices/labels. Fit statistical models on the 74 labeled training cases only. Validation feedback may choose strategy branches and prompt wording, never fit predictor coefficients or insert per-case labels into requests.
excluded_previous_test: The 30 earlier final-test cases and their labels are excluded from every new training/validation/tuning step. Their metadata may be read only to exclude duplicated sources and overlapping same-stock windows from the new holdout.

holdout.selection: Discover the same primary-source company archives for 2026, bounded at 100 pages per issuer and 100 Apple global pages; keep January-June. Group each issuer's articles in seven-calendar-day blocks. Reserve a risk-oriented title and financial-results title where available; fill remaining slots at evenly spaced date ranks with fixed seed 2718. Download only selected bodies and deterministic next-ranked replacements for inaccessible/invalid text before freezing. Add one real NASA APOD control per company. Every source, including controls, must pass exact source/text-duplication and same-stock target-session overlap checks against ALL earlier cases. Controls have no exception. Never select by returns.
holdout.failed_fixed_control: If an assigned NASA date is inaccessible or overlaps a prior window, try the next calendar day in ascending order for at most 14 days, recording each rejection before any holdout returns are fetched.
holdout.provenance: Actual source passages only, capped at 10000 characters; all labeled excerpts. Store source URL, displayed date, actual retrieval time, extraction selector, hashes and historical-version uncertainty.
holdout.sealed: Freeze case membership and source text before iteration 1. Do not acquire prices after 2025-06-30 or create holdout labels until all ten iterations finish and the selected configuration and code are frozen. Evaluate selected strategy and predeclared baselines once. Never tune after that result.

target: Unchanged: first regular-session open strictly after end-of-date New York cutoff through fifth regular-session close, counting entry as one. Raw price return; up >+1%, flat inclusive +/-1%, down <-1%. Reuse frozen target/calendar/label functions. Split windows or missing bars remain unscored, with no replacement after freeze.

response_policy.validation: Existing strict typed validator, concrete version check, probability sum tolerance 1e-6; preserve invalid responses; no normalization or retry because of accuracy
response_policy.retries: Identical request only, bounded 2/5-second backoff, respect Retry-After up to 60 seconds; no auth-error retries
response_policy.cache: Exact model/state/questions hash; completed and exhausted attempts retained

market_context: Only saved pre-cutoff 1/5/20-session stock and SPY returns, 20-session volatilities and relative returns. A frozen training-only market model may provide forecast probabilities; those are predictions, never realized outcome labels.

branches.name: market_aware_direct
branches.change: One direct forecast with market context, a precise executable window and explicit distinction between uncertainty and a flat return.

branches.name: business_then_trade
branches.change: Separate business/evidence interpretation from the subsequent tradable-return decision; pass original questions and definitions with answers.

branches.name: continuation_reversal_tree
branches.change: Assess pricing/continuation mechanisms, route irrelevant or unsupported news to the fixed market forecast, and ask a branch-specific final question otherwise.

branches.name: bull_bear_adjudication
branches.change: Independent typed bull and bear evidence assessments followed by a neutral adjudication of five-session returns.

branches.name: horizon_features_logistic
branches.change: New short-horizon economic/evidence features plus the same pre-cutoff market features; training-only balanced logistic regression, C=0.05; record matched market-only ablation.

branches.name: pricing_features_shallow_tree
branches.change: Rephrase around what remains after the entry open and realized versus intended actions; training-only decision tree, depth 2 and minimum leaf 12; matched market-only ablation.

branches.name: ordered_return_thresholds
branches.change: Ask separate probability questions for return below -1% and return at most +1%, then convert the ordered cumulative probabilities to three classes. If inconsistent, pool the two CDF values at their mean and record the conflict; this is a declared reconciliation, not alteration of invalid API output.

branches.name: reverse_wording_ensemble
branches.change: Reverse option order and emphasize continuation versus repricing; average this fresh forecast with the best earlier direct/staged branch. No optimized weights.

branches.name: market_regime_question_tree
branches.change: Use pre-cutoff market drawdown, relative momentum and Jev relevance to select bearish-regime, reversal-risk or neutral question wording; unsupported economic news falls back to market probabilities.

branches.name: retained_branch_ensemble
branches.change: Equal-probability average of the three earlier candidates with best validation accuracy, breaking ties with the declared ranking. No new fitting or calls.

baselines: same predictor without Jev features for selected learned branch
reporting: Report every iteration, exact questions and stage graph, train/validation metrics, coverage, retention, final selected results, failure cases and whether 70% was reached on validation and fresh holdout separately. Selective accuracy is separate and cannot satisfy the 70% full-coverage goal.
limitations: Model training may contain historical outcomes
Five technology stocks and small validation/holdout
Repeated validation optimization can overfit that development set
Shared macro exposures remain dependent despite same-stock window exclusions
